title: Bias in, Bias out: Annotation Bias in Multilingual Large Language Models
reasoning: The paper includes 'moral judgment' and 'morality' within its core typology of subjective annotation tasks and recommended taxonomies for bias mitigation. It also evaluates its proposed methods using benchmarks focused on ethical and social constructs such as misogyny, hate speech, and offensiveness (ArMIS, HS-Brexit, and MD-Agreement).
